layout_strategy.grid_system: Use the 'Tetris' grid for marketing sections (asymmetrical). Use dense grids for product listings.
layout_strategy.spacing: Generous. Use py-20 or py-32 for section vertical padding.
layout_strategy.alignment: Left-aligned text for readability, but visually balanced with images on the right.

assets.icons: Use Lucide-react for UI icons (ShoppingBag, Menu, Heart, Star, ChevronRight, Mail, Instagram, Facebook).

Hero.style: Split layout. Left: Typography with 'Playfair Display', Tagline in 'La Belle Aurore'. Right: Organic collage of images or a single hero image with 'torn paper' edge mask.
Hero.cta: Pill-shaped button, Terracotta background, text-white, hover:scale-105 transition-transform.

ProductCard.style: Clean white card on beige bg. Rounded corners. Image takes 70% height. Typography: Playfair for title, Manrope for price. 'Add to Cart' appears on hover.
ProductCard.interaction: Scale up slightly on hover. Shadow increases.

CategoryGrid.style: Bento/Tetris grid. Mix large and small squares. Each item is a link to the collection.
CategoryGrid.overlay: Gradient overlay on hover with text reveal.

Testimonials.style: Horizontal scroll or simple grid. Card style: 'Paper' texture background (off-white), Serif italic text for quote.

Navbar.style: Floating, glassmorphism but warm (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md). Logo left, Nav links center, Icons (Cart/Search) right.

universal_guidelines: Use 'Playfair Display' for all Headings (h1, h2, h3).
Use 'La Belle Aurore' for small accent notes, tags, or the 'Magic' keyword.
Do NOT use pure black (#000000). Use Charcoal (#2D2A26).
Do NOT use standard blue for links. Use Terracotta (#C66C49) or Sage (#7D8F69).
Add 'texture' where possible—grain or paper noise opacity 0.05.
Buttons should be rounded-full (pill shape) for a friendly, organic feel.
Images should have rounded corners (rounded-2xl) to match the soft aesthetic.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is #2D2A26 on #FDFBF7 (Passes AAA). White text on #C66C49 buttons.
accessibility.interactive: All buttons must have :focus-visible states with a ring offset.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to the head of index.html or top of index.css.
2. CONFIG TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js with the 'colors' and 'fontFamily' specified above.
3. BUILD HEADER: Create a responsive Navbar with the specified links.
4. BUILD HERO: Implementation 'Wrap Moments in Magic' with the mixed typography.
5. BUILD CATEGORIES: Use the image URLs provided in 'assets.images.categories'.
6. BUILD FEATURED: Use a mocked list of products with the specific Giftyne wrapping paper images found.
7. BUILD WHY SECTION: Use the extracted icon URLs.
8. BUILD FOOTER: Simple, elegant, large typography.
9. ANIMATION: Use 'framer-motion' for simple fade-ins (opacity: 0 -> 1, y: 20 -> 0) on scroll.
